title: Implement sandbox_spec Record and Validator
instructions: Create the file: this chunk owns the module docstring, imports and constants. Define the sandbox_spec record exactly as the section 7 JSON model, with a validator that rejects missing or mistyped fields. Fields: image: str (configurable general-purpose sandbox image tag; the SRS example tag is a leftover of the removed canary and must not pull scientific libraries); network: str (e.g. "none"); memory_mb: int (e.g. 4096); cpus: int (e.g. 2); pids_limit: int (e.g. 512); tmpfs_size: str (e.g. "2g"); security_opt: list (e.g. ["no-new-privileges:true"]); cap_drop: list (e.g. ["ALL"]). Frozen dataclass with from_dict()/to_dict(). network must be 'none', cap_drop must contain 'ALL', security_opt must contain 'no-new-privileges:true', and memory_mb must not exceed 4096 (FR-007 slot size).
